'''YT-1300 battery regulator''' was a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] component used in [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]] such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. One was added to the ''Falcon'' sometime around [[15 ABY/Legends|15 ABY]].
